proof_body:
by
  intro R A B C A' B' C' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f g f' g' a b c _ hfg hgs hf' hfg' _ h1 h2 ha hc
  have h1' : ∀ x, f' (a x) = b (f x) := fun x => LinearMap.congr_fun h1 x
  have h2' : ∀ x, g' (b x) = c (g x) := fun x => LinearMap.congr_fun h2 x
  constructor
  · refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero b).2 fun x hx => ?_
    have hgx : g x = 0 := by
      apply hc.1
      rw [← h2', hx, map_zero, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (hfg x).1 hgx
    have hay : a y = 0 := by
      apply hf'
      rw [h1', hx, map_zero]
    have hy : y = 0 := ha.1 (hay.trans (map_zero a).symm)
    rw [hy, map_zero]
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hc.2 (g' y)
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hgs z
    have hk : g' (y - b x) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, h2', hz, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (hfg' _).1 hk
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := ha.2 w
    refine ⟨x + f v, ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, ← h1', hw, add_sub_cancel]
